candidates.decision_relevance: Would show whether the repeatedly cited proxy-breadth changes persisted or reversed, and permit comparison with price and relative-leadership changes without relying on unmatched endpoint snapshots.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily reviews repeatedly report proxy breadth with changing point-in-time membership and missing intraperiod sequence; weekly reviews also identify absent breadth history and timing as limits on testing persistence and sequence.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped proxy advancer/decliner counts with constituent membership
candidates.missing_history_problem: Available readings are sparse, use differing membership hashes, and sometimes come from after the decision cutoff. The prior breadth path and matched-universe changes cannot be reconstructed.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would distinguish persistent flow direction from isolated settled sessions and help assess whether reported flows aligned in time with price, breadth, and leadership changes.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily reviews repeatedly describe ETF context as a single prior settled session or as lacking a matched historical comparison; weekly reviews note divergent flows without specifying their temporal direction.
candidates.metric_name: Settled daily BTC and ETH ETF net flows
candidates.missing_history_problem: The supplied records contain isolated settled-session totals rather than a dated sequence, so persistence, reversals, and alignment with other observations are unavailable.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would permit prospective assessment of warning interpretations against subsequent price paths, while preserving the information available when each interpretation was recorded.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews report zero eligible prospective typed protection rows and missing warning timestamps and subsequent outcomes; daily reviews likewise report no eligible matured protection outcomes.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped warning observations linked to subsequent BTC and ETH price paths
candidates.missing_history_problem: Warning issuance times, frozen contemporaneous evidence, and linked forward outcomes are absent or ineligible, preventing assessment of post-warning upside and drawdown without hindsight leakage.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would make prior range and directional candidates auditable for ex-ante availability, outcome containment, and realized error rather than relying on candidate counts or retrospective summaries.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews repeatedly state that candidate specifications, issuance times, and matured outcomes are missing; daily reviews provide shadow candidates but no candidate-linked scoring history.
candidates.metric_name: Candidate-linked realized forecast outcomes with frozen issue timestamps and specifications
candidates.missing_history_problem: Candidate records and their eligible realized outcomes are not consistently supplied together, so precision, containment, and hindsight leakage cannot be checked.
